shadows.name: glass-chrome
shadows.purpose: Reflected edges and ambient depth for glass chrome.

motion.name: scroll-depth
motion.purpose: Toolbar opacity, edge and shadow transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;min-height:44px;border-radius:var(--radius-sm,12px);padding:11px 18px;font-family:system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.6;cursor:pointer;transition:background 180ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),transform 100ms;background:var(--accent-strong,#0068d9);color:var(--surface,#fff);border:1px solid transparent;box-shadow:0 2px 4px #007aff16,inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff26}.ds-btn-primary:hover{background:#005dc8;box-shadow:0 4px 10px #007aff24}.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--accent,#007aff); outline-offset:4px; }.ds-btn-primary:active{transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-btn-primary:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:default;transform:none}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-btn-primary{transition:none}}

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Alternative action on an opaque white control.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;min-height:44px;border-radius:var(--radius-sm,12px);padding:11px 18px;font-family:system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.6;cursor:pointer;transition:background 180ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),transform 100ms;background:var(--surface,#fff);color:var(--accent-text,#0063ce);border:1px solid var(--line,#dedee3)}.ds-btn-secondary:hover{background:#f0f6ff}.ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--accent,#007aff); outline-offset:4px; }.ds-btn-secondary:active{transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-btn-secondary:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:default;transform:none}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-btn-secondary{transition:none}}

components.name: Text Button
components.css: .ds-btn-text{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;min-height:44px;border-radius:var(--radius-sm,12px);padding:11px 18px;font-family:system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.6;cursor:pointer;transition:background 180ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),transform 100ms;gap:6px;padding:8px 10px;background:transparent;border:1px solid transparent;color:var(--accent-text,#0063ce);font-weight:400;font-size:16px}.ds-btn-text:hover{background:var(--wash,#eaf3ff)}.ds-btn-text:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--accent,#007aff); outline-offset:4px; }.ds-btn-text:active{transform:translateY(1px)}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-btn-text{transition:none}}

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Opaque field for helper search or note input.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" aria-label="단어 찾기" placeholder="단어 찾기">
components.css: .ds-input{min-width:0;max-width:100%;border:1px solid #b9bdc7;border-radius:var(--radius-sm,12px);padding:11px 14px;background:var(--surface,#fff);color:var(--ink,#1d1d1f);caret-color:var(--accent,#007aff);font-family:system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;font-size:16px;line-height:1.6}.ds-input::placeholder{color:var(--muted,#6e6e73);opacity:1}.ds-input:hover{border-color:#b9bdc7}.ds-input:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--accent,#007aff); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation
components.description: Icon and label navigation with a white selected row.
components.html: 서재읽기 노선
components.css: .ds-nav{display:grid;gap:5px;padding:14px;border-radius:var(--radius-lg,24px);background:linear-gradient(155deg,#ffffffd9,#edf2faa6);border:1px solid var(--glass-border,rgb(255 255 255 / 88%));box-shadow:var(--glass-shadow,inset 0 1px 0 #fffffff5,inset 0 -1px 0 #ffffff73,0 2px 6px #232d4608,0 16px 44px #232d4612);backdrop-filter:blur(24px) saturate(155%);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(24px) saturate(155%)}.ds-nav-link{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-height:46px;padding:11px 14px;border-radius:12px;color:#565963;text-decoration:none;font-family:system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:550;transition:background 180ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),color 180ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}.ds-nav-link:hover{background:#ffffff70;color:var(--ink,#1d1d1f)}.ds-nav-link[aria-current=page]{background:#fffffff2;color:var(--accent-text,#0063ce);box-shadow:0 1px 2px #16233b08,0 3px 9px #16233b08,inset 0 1px 0 #fff}.ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--accent,#007aff); outline-offset:4px; }@media(prefers-reduced-transparency:reduce),(prefers-contrast:more){.ds-nav{background:#fff;backdrop-filter:none;-webkit-backdrop-filter:none}}@supports not ((backdrop-filter:blur(1px)) or (-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(1px))){.ds-nav{background:#fff}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-nav-link{transition:none}}

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Wrapping catalog filter with a raised selected state.
components.css: .ds-filters{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}.ds-chip{min-height:44px;padding:8px 16px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:var(--radius-sm,12px);background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#1d1d1f);font-family:system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;cursor:pointer;transition:background 140ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),transform 100ms}.ds-chip:hover{background:#f0f4f9}.ds-chip[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--surface,#fff);color:var(--accent-text,#0063ce);box-shadow:0 2px 6px #18233808}.ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--accent,#007aff); outline-offset:4px; }.ds-chip:active{transform:translateY(1px)}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-chip{transition:none}}

components.name: Reading Paper
components.description: Opaque article container; glass remains outside the learning text.
components.html:
상황부터 떠올려 주세요

차분히 읽고, 내 말로 이해하는 공간입니다.

components.name: Reader Toolbar
components.description: Glassy helper group outside the opaque article.
components.html: 1 / 8
components.css: .ds-reader-tools{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;min-height:58px;padding:6px 12px 6px 22px;border-radius:var(--radius-md,16px);background:var(--glass-fill,rgb(255 255 255 / 64%));border:1px solid var(--glass-border,rgb(255 255 255 / 88%));box-shadow:var(--glass-shadow,inset 0 1px 0 #fffffff5,inset 0 -1px 0 #ffffff73,0 2px 6px #232d4608,0 16px 44px #232d4612);backdrop-filter:blur(24px) saturate(155%);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(24px) saturate(155%);font-family:system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif}.ds-reader-count{font-size:12px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--muted,#6e6e73)}.ds-reader-actions{display:flex;gap:4px}.ds-reader-action{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;min-height:40px;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:var(--radius-sm,12px);background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#1d1d1f);font:inherit;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;transition:background 140ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),transform 100ms}.ds-reader-action:hover{background:#ffffffad}.ds-reader-action[aria-expanded=true]{background:white;color:var(--accent-text,#0063ce);box-shadow:0 1px 4px #1823380a}.ds-reader-action:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--accent,#007aff); outline-offset:4px; }.ds-reader-action:active{transform:translateY(1px)}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-reader-tools{padding:5px 8px;gap:6px;min-height:54px;border-radius:15px}.ds-reader-action{min-height:44px;padding:8px 9px}}@media(prefers-reduced-transparency:reduce),(prefers-contrast:more){.ds-reader-tools{background:#fff;backdrop-filter:none;-webkit-backdrop-filter:none}}@supports not ((backdrop-filter:blur(1px)) or (-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(1px))){.ds-reader-tools{background:#fff}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-reader-action{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
A light, quiet workspace gives each subject its own book identity while keeping the controls familiar. System typography, cool neutral surroundings, white content and restrained blue actions follow the user's Apple macOS / Liquid Glass direction.

Translucency belongs to the navigation and helper layer. The sidebar, toolbars, mobile dock and helper sheets use reflected edges and soft depth; article text sits on opaque white paper. The reading surface remains calm through long explanations, Japanese examples and interactive exercises.
keyCharacteristics: Light-only workspace with opaque white reading content.
System fonts throughout the shell and reading experience.
Blue actions and selected states; preserved subject colors identify books.
Restrained glass navigation with accessible opaque fallbacks.
Compact controls around a generously spaced reading column.

rules.name: The Reading Paper Rule
rules.body: Article text uses an opaque white surface. Glass belongs to navigation, toolbars and helper overlays.

rules.name: The Single Interface Accent Rule
rules.body: Use blue for interface actions and selected states; retain subject colors for their existing content identities.

rules.name: The Platform Type Rule
rules.body: Continue the approved system font stack in new surfaces, including headings.

rules.name: The Scroll Depth Rule
rules.body: After the window scroll exceeds `16px`, the route toolbar gains opacity, a lower edge and a diffuse shadow; the mobile top chrome similarly becomes more opaque.

dos: Do keep article text on opaque white paper.
Do use the approved system font stack throughout.
Do reserve glass for navigation, toolbars and helper overlays.
Do preserve subject-colored book identities and existing semantic feedback colors.
Do carry keyboard focus, safe-area spacing, reduced-motion and opaque fallback behavior into new surfaces.
Do wrap narrow layouts and keep wide tables inside local scrolling containers.
donts: Don't introduce a dark visual mode into this light-only system.
Don't restore the former warm-paper, green-ink or display-serif theme.
Don't put reading paragraphs on translucent or blurred backgrounds.
Don't replace books with unrelated decorative image cards.
Don't use motion or stronger glass as a substitute for clear text hierarchy.
